profile.currentPosition: Frontend Engineer at PT Global Energi Lestari
bio: I'm a **Frontend Engineer** with {{years}} years building products people actually use — from logistics platforms and travel marketplaces to gold investment apps and enterprise procurement systems.

My journey started with **Vue.js + Laravel**, evolved through **Nuxt.js** at scale with Evermos, and has now deepened into the **Next.js + TypeScript** ecosystem — crafting modular architectures, SSR patterns, i18n systems, and shared component libraries.

I care deeply about **clean architecture**, developer experience, and shipping things that are both fast and maintainable. Currently also exploring the AI tooling space, local LLMs, and full-stack territory.
